notes: «بهذا الإسناد نحوه» closes the main route as a back reference; no previous report in the context, so it is written as it stands.
«قد روي عن قابوس بن أبي ظبيان، عن أبيه ... مرسلا» is Tirmidhi naming a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, never a route (rule 4).
«وفي الباب عن سعيد بن زيد ...» names other reports of the chapter, not this saying: left out.
